verdict.rationale: Secureframe offers 'Comply AI' features (policy drafting, risk assessment automation, vendor doc Q&A, IaC fix generation) that act as embedded AI assistants for specific compliance tasks, which is evidence of delegatable AI-driven work inside the product. However, there's no single unified 'AI assistant' persona/chat interface described that a user can delegate arbitrary tasks to — the AI capabilities are siloed per feature (policies, risk, vendor review) rather than a general-purpose in-app assistant. missing for 10: a unified conversational AI assistant UI, evidence of open-ended task delegation beyond specific point features, independent/hands-on confirmation of these AI features working as claimed.
